channel.title: The New York Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The New York Times (nytimes.com)

item.title: In Ukraine, a Community of ‘Simple Believers’ Shuns the Modern World
item.description: The Christians known as viruiuchi prostaky see electricity, cars, higher education and much else as distractions from what really matters.

item.title: A Tale of Two Seasons at Columbia, and Two Responses to Student Arrests
item.description: When Mahmoud Khalil was detained by immigration agents last year, the university’s response was restrained. It was different with Elmina Aghayeva this week.

item.title: Epstein Effort to Finance a Dick Cavett Film Undone by Background Check
item.description: Jeffrey Epstein joined Mr. Cavett’s wife in an effort to create a PBS documentary on the talk-show legend. But then the producers did a background check on the financier.

item.title: QAnon Faithful See Validation in the Epstein Files
item.description: The nearly decade-old conspiracy theory does not align neatly with the facts emerging from the documents. That does not seem to matter.

item.title: See a Breakdown of Ayatollah Khamenei and Other Top Iranian Leaders
item.description: Among those killed in strikes, according to the U.S. and Israel, were Iran’s supreme leader and three of his top military commanders.

item.title: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Hard-Line Cleric Who Made Iran a Regional Power, Is Dead at 86
item.description: As Iran’s second supreme leader, he brutally crushed dissent at home and expanded Iran’s footprint abroad, challenging Saudi Arabia for regional dominance.
